title: Fix audio mute LED on Intel HD Audio laptops
summary: On some laptops with Intel HD Audio, the mute LED does not work by default. You can fix this by specifying the correct codec model for the snd_hda_intel kernel module.

steps.explain: Check if your laptop uses Intel HD Audio. If this command produces output, proceed.
Find your audio codec model name.
Look up your codec model in the kernel documentation list of available model names. If not found, try similar models.
Create the file /etc/modprobe.d/mute-led.conf with the following content to specify the model for the snd_hda_intel module. Replace <MODEL_NAME> with the model you found.
Reboot the system to apply the change.

warnings: If you need to test many models, you can reload the module without rebooting by stopping all graphical sessions first.
